title: Changes between two phone recordings of the same room
common_frame: Myroomesh1 PLY frame; metres; Z up; floor at z = -1.228 m

conventions.left_right: as seen when facing the window
conventions.distances: gaps between voxel surfaces (5 cm voxels), about +-5 cm
conventions.rotation: about the vertical axis, about +-10 deg
conventions.label_confident: true when Florence-2 and SigLIP 2 name the same object

summary: Between the two recordings, 3 objects were moved (suitcase, fan?, office chair), 1 piece of furniture was nudged (chest of drawers), 3 items no longer fill their spots (lamp?, bathroom cabinet?, plastic bag), 1 piece of furniture changed at its edge (desk) and 2 differences are depth-only (closet wall?, curtain). Depth-only means the object appears at that spot in both recordings' photos; only the measured depth differs. A question mark marks a label the two models did not agree on.

changes.title: chest of drawers nudged ~0.21 m
changes.label: drawer
changes.description: The white chest of drawers was pushed towards the bed by about 0.21 m (±0.05 m). Only its back and front faces changed (0.58 m apart); the rest of it stayed in place, so it was nudged, not carried somewhere else. It stands on the floor next to the bed.

rotation.note: not determinable: shape fits equally at every yaw

motion.interpretation: the removed and added parts are the trailing and leading faces of one larger object that stayed in place between them; it slid by about the thickness of the changed layers plus the surface tolerance, not by the face-to-face distance

before.text: on the floor next to the bed

after.text: on the floor next to the bed

changes.title: suitcase moved 0.54 m, turned ~100°
changes.label: suitcase
changes.description: The blue suitcase was moved 0.54 m and turned by roughly 100° (±10°). It was on the floor near the chest of drawers; it is now on the floor by the window wall. It is now further away from the chest of drawers: 1.15 m from it, compared with 0.45 m before. It is now closer to the window: 0.77 m from it, compared with 1.05 m before. Its long side used to be parallel to the right-hand wall (10° off); now it is perpendicular to it (71°).

changes.title: closet wall?: depth-only difference
changes.label: closet wall
changes.description: A thin white vertical panel labelled “closet wall” (uncertain: the other model said “door”) near the footwear: the depth surfaces differ by more than 10 cm here (changed part: 0.95 × 0.11 m, 1.70 m tall), but the second recording's photos still show a closet door at this spot, so nothing was removed. Most likely the closet wall sits slightly differently, a thin or see-through surface read differently in depth, or the two recordings are locally misaligned here.

changes.title: change at the desk
changes.label: desk
changes.description: Part of the desk now fills space that was empty in the first recording (changed part: 0.41 × 0.15 m, 0.35 m tall). Either the desk was nudged or something at its edge changed; the labels only say it is the desk. The first recording's photos show the desk at this spot too, which fits a small nudge.

changes.title: curtain: depth-only difference
changes.label: curtain
changes.description: The brown curtain across the window appears in the photos of both recordings (the first recording's photos are labelled “curtain”), but only the second recording's depth registers it as a solid surface: a 1.4 m wide, 2.1 m tall sheet. So it was not opened or closed; most likely the depth sensor saw through the thin material in the first recording, or it hangs slightly differently. A fold that hangs further into the room (OA3) is included, merged because it has the same label and touches it.

changes.title: small changes

models.use: one question per view: main colour

limitations: Only space observed by both recordings can be compared; changes elsewhere are reported as unknown, not as removed (cross-observed fraction of occupied space: 0.4582).
Objects smaller than about a 15 cm cube are listed but not interpreted.
'Gone' means the space is empty in the second recording and no matching object was found in space both recordings observed; the object may have moved somewhere only one recording saw.
Labels marked label_confident=false come from one model only and can be wrong (the door is labelled 'closet wall').
